instruction: Close the Amazon search results tab (the one showing 'huggingface transformers book' search) and keep only the Amazon homepage open.

metadata.explanation: Task requires closing the search results tab while keeping the Amazon homepage. Uses existing is_expected_tabs metric to verify only amazon.com homepage remains open.
metadata.verification: The is_expected_tabs function checks if open tabs match the expected URLs list. Returns 1.0 if only amazon.com homepage is open, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_open_tabs_info getter to extract all open Chrome tabs with their URLs
The is_expected_tabs metric appropriately compares actual open tabs against expected URLs using list equality
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both requirements - search tab is closed AND homepage remains open
Expected value is semantically correct: https://www.amazon.com/ is the correct URL for Amazon homepage
URL comparison logic handles normalization properly (trailing slashes, www prefix, case) via compare_urls utility function
Data flow is logically sound: getter extracts tab list, metric compares using URL normalization, returns 1.0 only if tabs match exactly
No postconfig needed - tab state doesn't require UI reopening, which is correct for this task
Evaluator will work correctly at runtime without issues
